notes.title: new product BuDo2 is being developed by partners!
notes.content:
Brothers and sisters:After the announcement of authorizing the use of related resources such as the Martial Arts War Concubine IP and Fine Arts in March 2019, several products have been developed or launched. At present, our team is involved in supervising the use of the game IP, and the specific R & D is developed and operated by developers from Taiwan, Japan, Hong Kong and other non-mainland regions.

  BuDo2 is a chain travel product authorized and supervised by the martial arts war concubine production committee, developed by the martial arts war concubine association committee, and released by ButterSwap. It is hoped that brothers can not only play with their sisters in the virtual world, but also make money in the real world, making it easier for brothers to break away from groups and make friends!

  BuDo2 is still in the early stage of research and development and is not promoted for mainland users. It doesn't matter if you just want to invest in the game. If you want to rely on the game to make a quick fortune, you need to pay attention to the high risk!

notes.title: 3.8 update notice
notes.content:
You support our players, I'm very sorry, let you wait a long time!

Originally, we planned to add several new roles to DLC, but because we couldn't persuade the partners, we can't launch DLC at present, and we can't provide achievements because of the lack of art;

Due to the requirements of partners, we have not returned this game, and the price in a few regions has been increased!!! Discount at the time of promotion!

The main contents of this update are as follows:

1. Optimization loading stuck problem, if there is still feedback!

2. The problem of optimizing acquisition rotation fixation has been changed to full random to balance resources!

3. The contact information of the main interface has been reduced to the lower left corner to avoid visual experience;

We are ready for a new game. It is planned to be an RPG porn game. Crowdfunding will be launched then! Hope to be able to supplement our previous two games in the plot and play method!!!
